title: F5 Koroyd Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Klim F5 Koroyd Gloss Black is purpose-built for off-road riders demanding massive aerobic cooling and roost deflection, pairing extreme cooling throughput with competition-grade roost protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1299g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~98 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Revolutionary Koroyd liner crumple zone for superior impact protection.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for dirt/MX use; features a narrow visor and aggressive cheek pads for off-road clearance.

technical_analysis: Features Hand-laid Karbonite Carbon Fiber shell construction optimized for extreme adventure dual-sport touring paired with Fidlock magnetic quick-release chinstrap buckle with distortion-free optical shield and peak visor. The interior utilizes Klimatek cooling fabric interior with high-volume chin intake ventilation with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Klim F5 Koroyd Gloss Black: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Fidlock magnetic quick-release chinstrap buckle with distortion-free optical shield and peak visor and Klimatek cooling fabric interior with high-volume chin intake ventilation. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Klim F5 Koroyd Gloss Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Klim F5 Koroyd Gloss Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Klim's Dirt / MX lineup, the F5 Koroyd Gloss Black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Klim F5 Koroyd Gloss Black represents Klim's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Klim F5 Koroyd Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
